data.name: Half-Day Sail
data.headline: 4 Hour Private Charter
data.description: Escape the hustle and bustle with our most popular sailing trip-the half day sail! This charter kicks off with a leisurely sail along the intercoastal waterways to one of the best local shelling islands in Florida. Once at Shell Key, you'll have time to swim, snorkel, and look for shells before we begin our sail back to the marina.

meeting_point.address: 6800 Sunshine Drive South St. Petersburg, FL US 33705

data.cancellation_notes:
Customer Cancellation: Cancellations must be requested via call or email no less than 7 days before trip departure for a full refund. No shows will be charged full price. 

Weather Cancellations: If your trip's departure may be impacted by weather, our captains will reach out via text or email no less than 2hrs before departure with a weather update. Should the trip be canceled, guests are entitled to a full refund.
